subject.title: [Feature]: Per-user heartbeat routing for channel-level heartbeat messages

question: Should OpenClaw add a channel/account-scoped recipient contract that redirects only HEARTBEAT_OK acknowledgments while preserving existing alert and content delivery?
rationale: Source proves the capability is missing, but choosing a new public configuration surface and its security/precedence semantics requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Add OK-only recipients
options.body: Introduce one canonical recipient-list field with per-account precedence and channel-owned normalization and allowlist validation.

options.title: Use agent routing only
options.body: Reject a separate channel contract and document agents.defaults.heartbeat target/to or separate agent heartbeats as the supported operational model.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Keep showOk as an all-or-nothing visibility control and close the request as not worth additional configuration surface.

recommendation.title: Add OK-only recipients
recommendation.body: Introduce one canonical recipient-list field with per-account precedence and channel-owned normalization and allowlist validation.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history connects steipete to the original visibility merge, subsequent WhatsApp configuration work, routing refactors, and the prior decision-oriented review.
